title: Why Google Gemini 2.5 changes everything for developers

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Wait—what if AI could write code faster than you can type?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Google Gemini 2.5 is here, and it’s changing how developers work.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s the first model that writes clean, production-ready code in real time.
